svg.title: Where the study fits in metacognition
svg.desc: Cognition concerns the answer. Metacognitive monitoring asks how likely the answer is to be correct. Meta-metacognition, highlighted as the study focus, asks how trustworthy that confidence judgment is. Arrows point from each assessment to its target. Dashed arrows show that these judgments could inform metacognitive control: proceeding, checking or abstaining. Control is a potential application and is not tested here. These are conceptual distinctions from human metacognition research, not established separate internal mechanisms or an API call sequence. The study tests whether confidence review adds predictive information beyond ordinary answer reassessment.
